report.summary: The synth method estimated the patch effect on positive share at 0.98 percent at the 7-day horizon and 2.75 percent at the 14-day horizon. There were 0 sale days and 0 discount days during the window. Off-topic negative review share was 0.0 percent in the window and 0.0 percent in the baseline. The review composition metric changed by 0.59. Some players experienced frustration with the reworked farming system and content updates following version 0.8.117. Noise or seasonality is supported, while the patch is inconclusive. A price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are rejected.
